summary.text: Carol Brewer is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 89 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She defeated Jalon Britton in the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a wife, mother, business owner and advocate for families and children.

paragraphs.text: Carol Brewer was born in Wichita, Kansas, and attended Kapaun Mt Carmel and Wichita Heights High School.
She attended Texarkana College, Wichita State University and Colorado Tech, and her career experience includes working as a CEO.
She has been affiliated with Zeta Phi Beta Sorority Inc.
Brewer ran for the Kansas House of Representatives in District 98 in 2020, losing in the primary, and again in 2024, losing in the general election.
In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she supports Medicaid expansion in Kansas and full funding and adequate staffing for every school.
She listed KNEA/KPAC as an endorser and Children & Families as the committee area that interested her, and she wrote that being a foster parent has been a struggle in her life.
